name: content-warning
description: Web component for block and inline content warnings.

name: dynamic-datalist
description: Web component that enables you to dynamically update a field's `datalist` with values retrieved from a URL as the user types.

name: form-dropzone
description: A progressively enhanced file field wrapper with drag-and-drop support, accessible status announcements, and optional image previews.

name: form-fieldset-progress
description: Progressively enhance fieldsets into a validated step-by-step form.

name: form-matching-fields
description: Web component wrapper that adds additive validation to ensure two text-type fields match.

name: form-maxlength-progress
description: Indicates someone’s progress toward the limit of a field’s `maxlength` value.

name: form-multi-switch
description: Progressively enhance native radio groups into accessible light-DOM segmented controls.

name: form-obfuscator
description: Web component that obfuscates fields when they don't have focus

name: form-repeatable
description: A web component that enables you to control the duplication of fields.

name: form-required-checkboxes
description: Web component that enables requirement rules for checkbox groups.

name: form-required-if
description: Web component that enables fields to be required based on the value(s) of other fields.

name: form-saver
description: A web component that stores (and restores) values within the form it wraps.

name: form-show-if
description: Web component that enables you to make one HTML form field show (or not) based on the value(s) of another field.

name: form-validation-list
description: A web component comprising a list of validation rules for a field.

name: fullscreen-control
description: Fullscreen controls for video, embedded content, or an authored wrapper.

name: img-alt-overlay
description: Reveal an image's alternative text in a non-modal, in-image dialog

name: img-enlarge
description: Progressively enhance images with a dialog-based enlarged view and grouped navigation.

name: lazy-img
description: Web component that enables you to lazy load an image based on screen size.

name: print-link-list
description: Generate a deduplicated print-only list of links and citations.

name: pull-to-refresh
description: Web component that enables pull-to-refresh functionality.

name: script-dependent
description: Reveals authored content only after its module and optional initializer are ready.

name: tabbed-interface
description: A web component that transforms heading-structured content into an accessible tabbed interface.

name: table-modifiable
description: A web component that enables users to hide & show columns on an HTML table.

name: table-sortable
description: A web component to enable users to sort the data in a table based on table cell values.

name: theme-switcher
description: A light-DOM tri-state theme picker built on form-multi-switch.
